collection.title: Hummer H3 2006 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Hummer H3 2006 - 2010 model which requires a 16" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this H3, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
